hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: Table 4 'Economic Cost of Idaho Crashes: 2025 Estimates', p. 12 (PDF p. 17)
rules: ITD gives a cost per occurrence: per person killed or injured at each level, and per person uninjured for O (AIS to KABCO scales of USDOT's BCA guide, 2025 VSL)
CrashIQ prices each crash at its own level, as ITD's RP 287 does with the 2022 equivalents (Eq. 4, Table 2.1, p. 18)

statewide_rates.missing: ITD's annual report gives statewide crashes per 100 million VMT for all roads, not average rates by facility type, and CrashIQ has no Idaho traffic counts

screening.state_method: ITD's Highway Safety Corridor Analysis (HSCA) ranks corridors by crash rate and its High Accident Location (HAL) list by a weighted score of frequency, rate and severity (Idaho HSIP 2024 annual report to FHWA, p. 10 of 41)

min_years.missing: ITD's documents read here set no minimum study period for a corridor study

spf_calibration.missing: no Idaho calibration factors found in the documents read here
